delivery_notes.unicode_range_convention: Zero-based Unicode code-point indices, end-exclusive; UTF-8 SHA256 of each delivered range; complete-file source hash measured from exact original bytes.
delivery_notes.response_format: Exactly one contiguous range per source-text tool response, no aggregation; each range <=6000 Unicode characters; every exec response max_output_tokens=4500 (>=4000).
delivery_notes.truncation_check: Every delivery displayed matching END_SLICE start/end markers and reported original_token_count below the 4500 token cap. No truncation observed. Coverage and each slice hash were independently recomputed when constructing this report.
delivery_notes.source_lengths: Measured actual text lengths including trailing newline: Core FAQ 207859, Setup FAQ 14001. Provenance metadata counts omit one trailing newline; audited delivered bytes match manifest hashes.
delivery_notes.core_pdf: All 32 pages covered in the complete extracted text; actual PDF pages 6,7,17,32 rendered independently with PyMuPDF 1.5x and directly inspected. PDF hash measured from entire raw file.
delivery_notes.bc_pdf: Only page 6 scope-symbol legend inspected; all other expansion gameplay excluded from audit.
delivery_notes.source_authority: CORE p.32 directly points to official Living FAQ; focused entries follow the core Range clarification link. Current captured primary evidence supplied the needed rules, so no network retrieval was necessary.
delivery_notes.not_used: No catalog-cards.js set labels, prior helper reports or title/corner-only derivative strips were used to establish card membership. Storefront/catalog content and broad Range index were unnecessary after the exact primary focused captures were provided.
delivery_notes.candidate_preservation: Original candidate file read only; exact hash rechecked immediately before report creation. Canonical/source files were not edited.
delivery_notes.important_procedural_omissions: None found within stated scope and explicit individual component delegation.
delivery_notes.result_basis: All material candidate rule claims, procedures, numeric costs/counts/destinations, timing/order, exceptions, end conditions, initial +1 Blight/action-tree outcomes, Range eligibility/ownership/internal origins and named card scope checked against the supplied primary evidence.
